comment: Frozen 2026-10-10 after the Pixel baseline (pixel-base-1s1s: debug app at 8fb5028b = master b4af6990 plus the on-device trace only, Pixel 10 Pro, parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3-q4_k_m-shrink16 on the Vulkan fast engine, warm, 3 repeats per take, 1 s first-partial minimum / 1 s interval) and before any candidate run (issue #357). Relative rules compare against pixel-base-1s1s; noise allowances are wider than on the notebook because the phone heats up during a run and shares the CPU with the OS. Stop rules use the user's Stop (end of capture), see android_stream_replay.py.
